name: Hawthorne Heights
label: Victory
lede: Hawthorne Heights took its name from a hotel sign in Ohio, made Victory Records' biggest-selling debut, landed at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 and sued the label, all in about two years.

eras.title: A hotel sign gives Dayton a new name
eras.text: Before Hawthorne Heights there was A Day in the Life, a Dayton, Ohio band named after the Beatles song. When everyone but singer JT Woodruff quit, the band that replaced it took its name from a roadside hotel.

years.h: JT Woodruff starts a band in Dayton, Ohio, and names it for a Beatles song
years.p: Woodruff, Jesse Blair, Andy Saunders, Josh Bethel and Andy Lazier call it A Day in the Life. Their demo, Four Bullets for One Girl, sells its 500 copies in two months.

years.h: Paper Chromatography closes the A Day in the Life years
years.p: The six-song EP, Paper Chromatography: The Fade from Dark to Light, follows the album Nine Reasons to Say Goodbye on Confined Records.

years.h: Everyone but Woodruff quits, and Matt Ridenour finds a name on a hotel
years.p: Ridenour, the new bassist, spots a Hawthorn Inn & Suites and adds an "e" and "Heights". The band agrees on Hawthorne Heights in 2003.
years.xp:
After a little success as A Day in the Life, the whole band quit except Woodruff, according to Wikipedia. Ridenour joined on bass and backing vocals and came up with the new name.

The line-up that made the first record: Woodruff (vocals, rhythm guitar), Ridenour (bass), Micah Carli (lead guitar), Casey Calvert (rhythm guitar, screamed vocals) and Eron Bucciarelli (drums).

eras.title: Ohio Is for Lovers on MTV
eras.text: Victory Records put out the first Hawthorne Heights album in 2004 and it sold slowly until MTV started playing one video. That video turned a Dayton emo band into Victory's biggest-selling debut.

years.h: MTV plays Ohio Is for Lovers, and the debut finally sells
years.p: The Silence in Black and White was recorded in four weeks and sold slowly until the video hit rotation. It peaked at No. 56 on the Billboard 200 and went gold, per Wikipedia.
years.xp: Wikipedia calls it Victory's highest-selling debut album, and places Hawthorne Heights among the biggest breakouts of the 2000s emo explosion. Calvert's screams against Woodruff's melodies became the band's sound.
play: The Silence in Black and White

years.h: Victory pulls Niki FM and Silver Bullet from the debut
years.p: Both singles come out in 2005, a year after The Silence in Black and White.

eras.title: The lawsuit year, and the loss of Casey Calvert
eras.text: The second album debuted at No. 3, and a Victory marketing stunt in the band's name nearly buried it. Hawthorne Heights sued its label that summer. In November 2007, guitarist Casey Calvert was found dead on the tour bus in Washington, D.C.

years.src: Wikipedia: Hawthorne Heights · Wikipedia: Victory Records
years.h: Victory tells fans to hide Ne-Yo's CDs, in the band's name
years.p: The week If Only You Were Lonely went up against [[Ne-Yo|a4a01f5d-18e7-4571-8c3a-76ec0e24e2d7]]'s In My Own Words, statements went out under the band's name urging fans to hide Ne-Yo's CD in stores. Hawthorne Heights said it never agreed.
years.xp:
According to Wikipedia, the statements asked fans and street team members to conceal copies of Ne-Yo's album so Hawthorne Heights could take the top chart spot. The line above comes from Victory's statement, issued in the band's name.

The band later said the label made the statements without their consent, and the stunt became part of their lawsuit against Victory.

years.h: If Only You Were Lonely opens at No. 3 on the Billboard 200
years.p: It also takes No. 1 on the Independent Albums chart. The single Saying Sorry reaches No. 7 on Modern Rock and goes gold.

years.h: A remix of a Hawthorne Heights song goes into Underworld: Evolution
years.p: The Legion of Doom remix of Where Can I Stab Myself in the Ears? lands on the film's soundtrack, retitled with "Do I". [[Atreyu|17e137fb-59e5-4fd7-af48-afc34995396c]] is on it too.

years.cap: Hawthorne Heights on stage, Nintendo Fusion Tour, c. 2006
years.h: Hawthorne Heights plays Nintendo Fusion and Warped in the same year
years.p: MTV, VH1 and Fuse keep the videos in rotation while the band works both tours.

years.src: Wikipedia: Hawthorne Heights · Wikipedia: Victory Records
years.h: A website manifesto: Hawthorne Heights quits Victory and sues Tony Brummel
years.p: The suit alleges fraudulent accounting, breach of contract, copyright and trademark infringement, fraud and abuse.
years.xp:
In September 2006 Victory countersued for breach of contract and libel. On October 20, 2006, a Chicago judge dismissed two of the band's three main claims, finding the trademark and copyright claims unsound.

Wikipedia's Victory Records article adds that in January 2008 the label sued Virgin/EMI for $10 million in actual damages plus $25 million punitive.

years.h: A federal judge rules Victory has no exclusive hold on the band
years.p: The label holds no exclusive rights to Hawthorne Heights' recording services. On May 17 the judge adds a catch: the band still owes Victory two albums.

years.h: Casey Calvert dies on the tour bus in Washington, D.C.
years.p: Calvert, 26, was found before soundcheck at the 9:30 Club, a day after the tour opened in Detroit. The D.C. medical examiner ruled it an accidental combined drug intoxication.
years.xp:
The autopsy, released in December 2007, found a fatal interaction between citalopram (an antidepressant), clonazepam and an opiate. Calvert had been prescribed Vicodin for a root canal before the tour. Eron Bucciarelli said Calvert had wrestled with depression and that his medications were properly prescribed.

The band said it would not replace him. Bucciarelli added they didn't need another screamer.

eras.title: Four become one
eras.text: The lawsuit ended with Hawthorne Heights back on Victory for one more album, made as a four-piece with Micah Carli taking over Calvert's screams. Then the band moved to Wind-up, and Victory collected the hits.

years.cap: JT Woodruff and Micah Carli at the Crocodile Rock
years.h: Fragile Future is the first album without Casey Calvert
years.p: Released on Victory after the legal settlement and produced by Jeff Schneeweis, with Carli on the screamed vocals. Lead single Rescue Me came out July 22.
years.xp: The band wrote Four Become One and Sugar in the Engine to honor Calvert.

years.h: Projekt Revolution puts Hawthorne Heights next to Atreyu
years.p: On [[Linkin Park|f59c5520-5f46-4d2c-b2c4-822eabf53419]]'s 2008 tour the band plays the Revolution Stage with Atreyu, Armor for Sleep, 10 Years and Street Drum Corps.

years.h: Wind-up Records signs Hawthorne Heights
years.p: The band posts the news on MySpace and says Carli will do the screaming on the next album.

years.h: Skeletons is the Wind-up album, and it peaks at No. 50
years.p: The Billboard 200 peak is for the band's fourth album. Carli adds ukulele and mandolin to bonus tracks, and Nervous Breakdown is the single.

years.h: Victory compiles Midwesterners: The Hits from the band it sued
years.p: Sixteen songs from Hawthorne Heights' three Victory albums.

eras.title: Cardboard Empire
eras.text: Out of the major-label system, Hawthorne Heights started its own label and put out EPs. Two of the three men who'd been there since the first album left within a year of each other.

years.h: Hawthorne Heights leaves Wind-up and starts its own label, Cardboard Empire
years.p: The label plans a trilogy of EPs. Hate comes out August 23, two days after it leaked online.

years.h: New Winter puts the band back on MTV after nearly five years
years.p: The single comes from the Hope EP. A European tour includes an interview in a bathtub.

years.h: Mark McMillon joins as the band makes Zero
years.p: The concept album, on Red River Entertainment, takes the place of the planned third EP. McMillon of The Story Changes is announced as a member, and the band plays every date of Warped Tour.

years.h: Ten years on, Hawthorne Heights re-records its debut acoustic
years.p: The acoustic The Silence in Black and White on InVogue Records is launched with a tour starting at Fibber Magees in Dublin.

years.h: Drummer Eron Bucciarelli leaves Hawthorne Heights
years.p: He had drummed on every album since the first.

years.h: Guitarist Micah Carli quits Hawthorne Heights
years.p: Carli had taken over Calvert's screams in 2008. The trilogy closes that September with the Hurt EP.

eras.title: Pure Noise and the long haul
eras.text: Down to JT Woodruff, Matt Ridenour and Mark McMillon, Hawthorne Heights found a home at Pure Noise Records and a spot on the anniversary-tour circuit its own era created.

years.h: Bad Frequencies lands on Pure Noise
years.p: The band's sixth album is led by Pink Hearts. They tour it opening Silverstein's 15th anniversary run.

years.h: Cameron Webb produces The Rain Just Follows Me
years.p: Ten songs; lead single Constant Dread features Brendan Murphy of Counterparts. After the pandemic they tour with Bayside and Senses Fail.

years.h: Five new songs on the Lost Lights EP
years.p: Out on Pure Noise.

years.h: Chris Popadak leaves the drum seat without an announcement
years.p: Dango Cellan of Amber Pacific has drummed at Hawthorne Heights' shows since.

years.h: Hawthorne Heights is direct support on Chiodos' 20th anniversary tour
years.p: The run marks All's Well That Ends Well at 20. Off the road, JT Woodruff and his wife run Greenhaus Coffee in Sidney, Ohio.
